f3_program: collection("national_park.bears", "bear", "national_park", source("bears in a national park"))
multiple(at("national_park.bears.black.count", "current"), at("national_park.bears.white.count", "current"), 2, source("twice as many black bears as white bears"))
offset(at("national_park.bears.brown.count", "current"), at("national_park.bears.black.count", "current"), 40, "count", source("40 more brown bears than black bears"))
observe(at("national_park.bears.black.count", "current"), 60, "count", source("the number of black bears in the park is 60"))
query("sum", "national_park.bears", "current")
observe(at("marie.cash_register.cost", "current"), 1040, "currency", source("cash register for her bakery that costs $1040"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.bread.sold.count", "per_day"), 40, "count", source("Every day Marie sells 40 loaves of bread"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.bread.unit_price", "current"), 2, "currency", source("40 loaves of bread for $2 each"))

product_relation(at("marie.bakery.bread.sales_revenue", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.bread.sold.count", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.bread.unit_price", "current"), source("Every day Marie sells 40 loaves of bread for $2 each"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.cake.sold.count", "per_day"), 6, "count", source("6 cakes for $12 each"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.cake.unit_price", "current"), 12, "currency", source("6 cakes for $12 each"))
product_relation(at("marie.bakery.cake.sales_revenue", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.cake.sold.count", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.cake.unit_price", "current"), source("6 cakes for $12 each"))

sum_relation(at("marie.bakery.sales_revenue", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.bread.sales_revenue", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.cake.sales_revenue", "per_day"), source("Every day Marie sells 40 loaves of bread for $2 each and 6 cakes for $12 each"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.rent.cost", "per_day"), 20, "currency", source("$20 each day for rent"))
observe(at("marie.bakery.electricity.cost", "per_day"), 2, "currency", source("$2 each day for electricity"))

sum_relation(at("marie.bakery.operating_cost", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.rent.cost", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.electricity.cost", "per_day"), source("She has to pay $20 each day for rent and $2 each day for electricity"))

difference_relation(at("marie.bakery.profit", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.sales_revenue", "per_day"), at("marie.bakery.operating_cost", "per_day"), source("Every day Marie sells 40 loaves of bread for $2 each and 6 cakes for $12 each. She has to pay $20 each day for rent and $2 each day for electricity. How many days' worth of profits will it take for Marie to pay for the cash register?"))

rate_relation(at("marie.cash_register.cost", "current"), at("marie.bakery.profit", "per_day"), "marie.cash_register.payoff_duration.day_count", source("How many days' worth of profits will it take for Marie to pay for the cash register?"))
query("value", "marie.cash_register.payoff_duration.day_count")
collection("melanie.brownies", "brownie", "melanie", source("Melanie baked 10 batches of brownies"))
observe(at("melanie.brownie_batches.count", "initial"), 10, "count", source("10 batches of brownies"))
observe(at("melanie.brownies.per_batch.count", "initial"), 20, "count", source("20 brownies in each batch"))

product_relation("melanie.brownies.baked.count", at("melanie.brownie_batches.count", "initial"), at("melanie.brownies.per_batch.count", "initial"), source("10 batches of brownies, with 20 brownies in each batch"))
produce("bake", "melanie", at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), "melanie.brownies.baked.count", source("Melanie baked 10 batches of brownies"))

transfer("set_aside_for_bake_sale", "melanie", at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), at("bake_sale.brownies.count", "current"), fraction("melanie.brownies.baked.count", 3, 4), source("She set aside 3/4 of the brownies in each batch for a bake sale"))

difference_relation("melanie.brownies.remaining_after_bake_sale.count", "melanie.brownies.baked.count", event_field("set_aside_for_bake_sale", "quantity"), source("She set aside 3/4 of the brownies in each batch for a bake sale, put 3/5 of the remaining in a container"))

transfer("put_in_container", "melanie", at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), at("container.brownies.count", "current"), fraction("melanie.brownies.remaining_after_bake_sale.count", 3, 5), source("put 3/5 of the remaining in a container"))

difference_relation("melanie.brownies.given_out.count", "melanie.brownies.remaining_after_bake_sale.count", event_field("put_in_container", "quantity"), source("put 3/5 of the remaining in a container, and gave out the rest"))
remove("give_out", "melanie", at("melanie.brownies.count", "current"), "melanie.brownies.given_out.count", source("gave out the rest"))
query("value", event_field("give_out", "quantity"))
observe(at("autodesk.goodwill.ending", "2018"), 1620.2, "million_currency", cell("Goodwill, end of the year", "January 31, 2018"))
observe(at("autodesk.goodwill.ending", "2019"), 2450.8, "million_currency", cell("Goodwill, end of the year", "January 31, 2019"))
query("mean", at("autodesk.goodwill.ending", "2018"), at("autodesk.goodwill.ending", "2019"))
